hi_licenza.titolo: General Steps on Becoming a Hawaii Licensed Real Estate Salesperson on Active Status

frasi.ore: Successfully complete a 60 hour Hawaii salesperson prelicensing course.
frasi.certificato: School Completion Certificates are valid two (2) years from the date of issuance
frasi.domanda: Within two (2) years of passing the Hawaii salesperson’s examination, submit a complete application for a Hawaii real estate salesperson’s license.
frasi.attivo: To be licensed on active status, the applicant must be employed or associated with a current and active Hawaii licensed real estate brokerage firm or sole proprietor.

frasi.eta: You must be at least 18 years of age as of the date of the examination.
frasi.diploma: You must have earned a high school diploma or equivalent
frasi.cittadinanza: You must be a United States citizen, a United States national, or an alien authorized to work in the United States.

frasi.psi: PSI administers the Hawaii real estate licensing examination.
